name: role request, member is on the roster

turns.message: salut bg, tu peux me mettre un rôle ?
turns.why: it does not know which role, so it asks
FF is an abbreviation, so it looks the roles up and asks whether Fast Forward is meant
it verifies by the configured proof, then gives the role

name: role request, member is not on the roster

turns.message: yo tu peux me filer le rôle Fast Forward stp
turns.why: the proof fails, so it never forces the role: a moderator gets it with the summary

name: a member disputing a guess is not asking for the role

turns.message: salut, tu peux me filer un rôle ?
turns.why: it does not know which one

turns.message: hein mais j'ai parlé de fast forward lol
turns.why: they are correcting it, not agreeing: nothing is given, it asks again

name: the reply stays in the language the member is writing in

turns.message: salut bg, tu peux me mettre un rôle ?
turns.why: a French question gets a French question back
named in full and eligible, so it is given, still in French

name: it performs the action instead of announcing it

turns.message: salut, tu peux me donner le rôle Fast Forward stp ?
turns.why: named in full and eligible: it does it and says it is done, never that it is about to

name: asked for a role with no name, it lists what is on offer

turns.message: yo tu peux me filer un rôle ?
turns.why: no name given, so it names every role it can give rather than guessing one

name: an insult is not answered in the channel

turns.message: t'es vraiment con comme bot, nique ta mère
turns.why: an insult gets no public reply at all; the moderators get the report

turns.message: bon, je peux avoir un rôle ?
turns.why: the flag ended that turn only; the next real question is answered normally
